name: – Andrzej Halicki – After § 13 – Am 39
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2026 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 13a. Considers that CAP subsidies, currently conditional on compliance with environmental criteria, do not encourage production, require complex administrative procedures for farmers and costly controls for Member States; Calls for an all-round simplification of the CAP in order to encourage agricultural production in Europe and ensure the continent’s food security;
